authority_limit: This is a persisted independent Fresh BREAKER batch finding only. It does not remediate code, alter tests or workflows, configure GitHub, perform Owner Acceptance, merge, rebase, or post-merge verification.

finding.batch_failure_mechanism: The cross-repository review cannot reach independent readiness because platform, windows, host, evals, and .github resolve PATH bash before installed Git Bash. The docs subject is the known-good reference: it selects Git Bash candidates before PATH.
finding.reference_invariant: On native Windows, the trusted runner must select C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe, then C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\bash.exe, before accepting PATH resolution.
finding.impact: No material defect is asserted against SpanFabric/docs. Its status records the batch-level BREAKER_FAILED verdict only, so the six-repository lifecycle remains coordinated while the five affected subjects are remediated and independently re-reviewed.

known_good_reference.reason: Its Windows helper enumerates Git Bash locations before appending the PATH result.

verification_evidence.source_review: Confirmed directly in the reviewed helper ordering: docs selects Git Bash before PATH, unlike the five affected repositories.
verification_evidence.native_host_probe: Get-Command bash resolved C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.exe. A platform exact-head unit run produced 26 passed, 7 errors, and 1 failure at the trusted-runner helper boundary.
verification_evidence.hosted_ci: The exact reviewed heads had successful Ubuntu-hosted checks. Those checks do not establish native Windows host selection and are supporting evidence only.
verification_evidence.execution_limit: A post-review local Git Bash invocation was unavailable because Git Bash failed with NtCreateDirectoryObject status 0xC0000022 and WSL returned Wsl/E_ACCESSDENIED. This environment limitation does not alter the confirmed five-repository source-level defect.

required_remediation: Port the docs Git-Bash-first host-selection order to SpanFabric/platform, SpanFabric/windows, SpanFabric/host, SpanFabric/evals, and SpanFabric/.github.
Add regression proof that native Windows prefers C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe, then C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\bash.exe, before PATH.
Run a Windows trusted-runner CI or protected equivalent that executes immutable materialize-then-run verification.
Recompute all changed material subjects and review-subject digests.
Obtain a new independent Fresh BREAKER review for the remediated subjects.
required_regression_evidence: Regression coverage must demonstrate the required native Windows candidate order, not merely that a mock or Linux PATH command succeeds.
fresh_verification_requirement: Any remediation materially changes the affected reviewed subjects and invalidates their Fresh BREAKER evidence; each remediated subject must re-enter BUILDING and receive a newly bound independent Fresh BREAKER verdict.
